t: Fully waterproof safety boot with waterproof and breathable inner membrane. Leather and mesh upper. Rubber/PU outsole with built-in ‘Pro Nose’, where the outsole comes up over the toe area to offer additional resistance to wear. Features both steel toe and steel midsole for full protection as well as inbuilt anti-static properties. Padded collar and tongue, with a dual-density outsole, for comfortable all day wear.
